title: Spring review: layers, data access, errors, testing, security

objectives.text: Retrieve and apply layering, JPA mapping and query, validation and error handling, testing and security skills on mixed practice tasks without new material
Trace one request through security, controller, service, repository and error handling, and locate where a described defect (N+1 query, missing validation, open endpoint) would surface

minutes.basis: intake planning model under the new-course budget rule (workflow/docs/tools/validators.md, Reading time): no artifact.html exists yet, so modeledP50 is the intake target for a review page (9 minutes) and modeledWorstPath adds 2.5 minutes for the worst required route (two wrong graded attempts and wrong-first explores per interactive unit; course-1 measured worst-path gaps were 2.41-2.65 minutes above P50). budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)) = 12. The api-security module PR replaces modeledP50 with the frozen estimator P50 (workflow/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py, sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f) on the authored bytes, re-models the worst path, and keeps budget at least ceil(max(P50, worst path)) and at most 15; T14 then checks the day totals. See workflow/evidence/spring-boot/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
